column1: # 59% of Californians said they or a family member skipped or delayed care because of cost in the past year.

# Source: California Health Care Foundation and NORC at the University of Chicago, The 2026 CHCF California Health Policy Survey: 2,552 adults, October 3 to November 10, 2025; margin of error ±3.0 points overall, larger for income groups. Of those who skipped or delayed, 42% said their condition got worse.
